channel.title: Kimi K3 — The Marginal Token

item.title: AI model releases: 19–25 October 2026
item.description: A completed-week review, updated through the Kimi and MiniMax notes published on 26 October. New APIs, public weights, specialist models, and the price and access changes that affect a deployment.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro: lower API rates, downloadable weights still pending
item.description: Standard Pro costs one-third less than K3 at posted token rates. Highspeed has a separate tariff, while full weights are promised by 4 November.
